blocks.text: Computer programming mein program likhne ke chaar bunyadi qadam hain.

items: Code likhein: programming language mein hidayaat ka majmooa banayein.
Compile ya interpret: code ko aisi shakal mein badlein jo computer samajh sake.
Execute: kaam anjaam dene ke liye code chalayein.
Output: nataij dikhayein ya code ke mutabiq amal karein.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaunsa bunyadi programming ke amal ka hissa nahi: code likhna, compile ya interpret, execute, ghaltiyan nazar-andaz karna (MCQ 1)?
blocks.explanation: Ghaltiyan nazar-andaz karna, option (d); ghaltiyan dhoond kar theek karni hoti hain.

items: Programming ke qadam: code likhna, compile ya interpret, execute, output.
